page.overview:
Who is Nekomamushi?

Master Nekomamushi is a feline mink and the former guardian of the Whale Forest on Zou. He was one of the two rulers of the Mokomo Dukedom, dubbed the "Ruler of Night", holding the position from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. He and Inuarashi serve as retainers for the Kouzuki Family of Wano Country, as members of the Nine Red Scabbards.

Alongside Inuarashi he was once a member of the Whitebeard Pirates and Roger Pirates, serving under Kouzuki Oden. Pedro has claimed that he and Inuarashi must not be allowed to die because "the world is waiting for them". After Kaidou's fall from power, Nekomamushi became a yakuza boss in the Flower Capital.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Whole Cake Island and Wano Country Sagas.

Nekomamushi is a large, yellow feline mink with dark brown stripes, sharp teeth, claws, and a very thick striped tail. He has wild, bushy blonde hair resembling a lion's mane running around his neck and down his back, and there is a scar running from the left side of his forehead down to his cheek. His outfit consists of a large red robe decorated with orange and yellow circles, a pink haramaki around his waist, tan sandals, and a white shirt paired with white pants. In addition, he frequently smokes a . Like all the retainers of the Kouzuki Family, Nekomamushi bears the family crest somewhere on his body.
